additional_concerns: For node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83, node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e, node.ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94 and node.ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909, preservation of existing application processing becomes a substantive relief exclusion. The source establishes preserved processing but does not expressly establish that broader exclusion or its duration. The proposed interpretation remains unresolved.

Node.4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64 excludes legacy applications from scope rather than deciding their eligibility. This matches its narrower question but cannot resolve actual relief for those applications. Node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa likewise answers only substantive qualification.

The introductory immediate-effect language and the express 28 November 2025 commencement provision require reconciliation for actual dated reliance. The source does not specify a universal assessment-event or implementation-date test.

Missing external authority for actual procedural availability includes the relevant updated SFC FAQs and any authoritative transition clarification. The two supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying descriptions, so neither can reliably be assigned to those authorities. Applicable home-jurisdiction requirements are also needed to determine concrete home-compliance facts; the formulas merely accept those classifications.

No separate home-supervision condition should automatically be imported into item (ii) from the introductory purpose statement or item (i). Its necessity remains an interpretive question rather than an established omitted condition.

The scoped PRESERVES findings below concern only the post-authorisation UCITS scope claim; they do not validate transition exclusions, factual classifications, notification compliance or actual permission to bypass processing.
